title: Encore Estates - Rooftop deck & skyline views
description:
Luxury 7-bedroom retreat in the heart of Nashville’s Downtown Gulch—steps from dining, music and nightlife.
Sleeps 22 comfortably.
Walk 5 min to Broadway & Music Row
Fast, free Wi-Fi & 4K TVs
Chef’s kitchen with double appliances
Rooftop deck with skyline views
On-site washer & dryer
Your host replies in under an hour to ensure a seamless stay.

The space
Incredible views of downtown Nashville with just a few minute walk into the Gulch and a 3 minute Uber from the Broadway entertainment. You can't go wrong with this location! Amazing style and design throughout these vibrant, fun, exciting homes. Custom kitchens with professional appliances, designer spa-like baths with Italian tile and faucets, incredible lighting, soaring ceilings, unique and beautiful wall treatments, and rooftop decks with 360 degrees views of downtown make this the perfect choice for your next group trip or work getaway to Music city. Garage, Grill and Wifi provided.

This listing is two side-by-side units. Note: There are 4 cots stored in one unit and 2 cots stored on site in the other unit.

Unwind Luxury Vacations is the professional management company for this home, and committed to curating your 5-star experience.
